column2: an act to amend the social security contribution levy
act, no. 25 of 2022
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1.  (1)  This  Act  may  be  cited  as  the  Social  Security
Contribution Levy (Amendment) Act, No.      of 2025.
(2) The provisions of this Act, other than the provisions
of subsections (1), (2) and (3) of section 2, shall come into
operation on the date on which the Bill becomes an Act of
Parliament.
(3)  The  provisions  of  subsections  (1),  (2)  and  (3)  of
section  2  shall  be  deemed  to  have  come  into  operation  on
February  18,  2025,  July  1,  2025  and  January  1,  2026
respectively.
2. The First Schedule to the Social Security Contribution
Levy Act, No. 25 of 2022 is hereby amended as follows: -
